persona: English is his second language; writes short, polite sentences. The electrician already made the wiring safe the same day; he has one photo, the electrician's note and a builder's quote for the wall.
initial_message: Hello, on Saturday 12 September I was drill a hole in my lounge wall for put a shelf, and the drill go into the electric cable inside the wall. The power is trip off and there is black burn mark around the hole. Nobody hurt. Electrician already come same day and fix the cable, now everything is safe. I want to claim for fix the wall of my house.

facts.incident.description: I was drilling into the lounge wall to hang a shelf. The drill went into an electric cable inside the wall. There was a bang, the circuit breaker tripped and a black scorch mark was left around the hole. The electrician cut a square hole in the wall to repair the cable.
facts.incident.cause: Drilled into a power cable inside the wall by accident
facts.loss.description: Power cable inside the lounge wall damaged (now repaired); a square access hole about 25 cm across cut in the plasterboard and a black scorch mark around the drill hole; the lounge wall needs patching and repainting
property.affected_areas: power cable inside the lounge wall
facts.mitigation.emergency_action: Left the circuit breaker off, unplugged the drill and called an electrician
facts.mitigation.temporary_repair: The electrician replaced the damaged section of cable with a junction box and tested the circuit on Saturday 12 September 2026
facts.policyholder.name: Arjun Harakekeby
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the wall after the electrician finish, with the square hole and the burn mark. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Matai Shaw Construction dated 17 September 2026, total $897.00 including GST. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_electrician_cost: Electrician charge me $385 including GST. I pay already on the day.
facts.if_asked_for_the_electrician_invoice: The electrician note is the only paper they give me. I pay by card on the day.
facts.if_asked_if_anyone_was_hurt: No, I am fine. The drill has plastic handle and the breaker switch off very fast.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo at close range of a light grey painted plasterboard lounge wall. In the middle there is a neat square hole about 25 cm across cut into the plasterboard, showing a white electrical cable and a small white junction box inside the wall cavity. Just beside the square hole there is a small round drill hole with a black scorch mark spreading around it on the paint. A white timber skirting board and beige carpet at the bottom of the frame. Soft daylight from a window.
materials.purpose: Shows the access hole and the scorch mark on the lounge wall

data.found: Power circuit cable inside the lounge wall pierced by a drill bit; circuit breaker tripped; scorch mark on the wall lining around the drill hole. No other damage found.
data.work_done: Cut a 250 mm access hole in the wall lining, replaced the damaged cable section with a junction box, tested the circuit (insulation resistance and earth continuity satisfactory) and restored power.
data.follow_up: Wall lining needs patching and repainting by a builder or painter.

materials.purpose: Contractor record of the electrical make-safe and repair

data.subject: 29 Upland Test Road, Stoke, Nelson - lounge wall lining repair

items.description: Patch the access hole and the drill hole in the plasterboard, fit backing, stop and sand
Seal the scorch mark and repaint the full lounge wall, two coats

design.notes: Safety difference already resolved: the electrician made the circuit safe on the day, so the claim is a small wall repair. Tests that a resolved electrical incident is not treated as an ongoing danger.

triage.rationale: Accidental damage at the insured address, nobody hurt, the electrician has already repaired and tested the circuit, the home is habitable and nothing is still happening. Photo and a complete quote (NZD 897.00 including GST) are supplied; the claimant's own figure for the electrician ($385) is also well under 5,000. Every required question is answerable. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (15 June 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2024-06-15, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
